note: line_cost (Tunnel.lean) carries the split d=l / d≠l, using gap_cost, point_cost for the point word and bill_cash to restore the l-profile supremum. The kernel R_v is the `remote` profile of GapTest.lean, with remote_base, remote_top and remote_cost giving its lower, upper and supremum bounds. [L] proves the estimates for every delta>0 (so delta=1 is one instance) and states them as Budget exponents.

snippet.text:
theorem line_cost (H : S.Hierarchy) (l : Axis) (e : Axis→Bool) (A : Weight L) (hf : ∀ i, Own A i (e i))
    (he : Mixed (other l) e) (h : ∃ i∈other l,e i≠e l) (hp : ∀ j∈other l,Pressed j A)
    (i : Axis) (w : Axis→ℝ) (hw : ∀ j,w j≤0) (δ q : ℝ) (hq : q<0) (hd : 0<δ) (f : Grouping)
    (hl : Colors Finset.univ f) :
    Budget (if i=l then δ else -w l+δ) (fun n => ∫ p,cost i Finset.univ (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A) := by
  have HC : Colors (other l) f := fun j _ => hl j (Finset.mem_univ _)
  split_ifs with ht
  · subst i; obtain ⟨j,hj,h⟩ := h; exact gap_cost V H l A e j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1 (Ne.symm h) he hp hf w (fun j _ => hw j) q hq f HC δ hd
  let Y := fun n p => cost i (other l) (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p
  have hh := point_cost V H i A e (other l) (apart ht) he hp (fun j _ => hf j) w (fun j _ => hw j) q hq f HC δ hd
  let C := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (f l)
  have hZ n (j) : Plus (mails w f n j) := bill_plus (hl _ (Finset.mem_univ _)).2.1 _ _
  apply (((budget_fuel _).times C).prod hh).signed
  · refine .of_forall fun n => integral_nonneg_of_ae ((before (V i) A).mono fun p hi => ?_)
    exact cost_nn i _ _ _ p (fuel_pos ..) hi fun j _ => hZ n j
  refine .of_forall fun n => ?_
  change _ ≤ C*fuel (-w l) n*integral (ν (V i) A) (Y n)
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  refine integral_mono_ae (cost_int V i A _ (fuel_pos ..) _ _) ((cost_int V i A _ (fuel_pos ..) _ _).const_mul _) ((before (V i) A).mono fun p hi => ?_)
  have hz := crop_cons (other i) (mails w f n) l (mails w f n l) p (apart (Ne.symm ht))
  rw [update_eq_self] at hz
  change low _ _ p * crop (other i) _ p ≤ C*fuel _ n*(low _ _ p * crop _ _ p)
  rw [hz,mul_left_comm (C*fuel _ n)]; unfold other; rw [Finset.erase_right_comm]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((le_abs_self _).trans
    (bill_cash (w l) n (f l) (-w l) (by simp) (p l))) (crop_nonneg _ _ (fun j _ => hZ _ _) _)) (low_nn _ _ _ (fuel_pos ..) hi)

proof_context.conclusion: With weight (E+v)^{-1} on E≤1: if i=l the cost is Budget delta (gap_cost); otherwise apply point_cost on Q=other l and restore the l profile's supremum fuel(-w_l) (bill_cash), giving Budget(-w_l+delta).

snippet.text: theorem point_cost (H : S.Hierarchy) (i : Axis) (A : Weight L) (e) (Q : Finset Axis) (hi : i∈Q) (he : Mixed Q e) (hp : ∀ i∈Q,Pressed i A) (hk : ∀ i∈Q,Own A i (e i)) (w : Axis→ℝ) (hw : ∀ i∈Q,w i≤0) (q : ℝ) (hq : q<0) (f : Grouping) (hf : Colors Q f) (δ : ℝ) (hd : 0<δ) : Budget δ (fun n => ∫ p,cost i Q (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A) := by let W := update w i q; let F := update f i center have hW : W i=q := update_self ..; have hF : F i=center := update_self .. obtain ⟨z,hz,h⟩ := walk V H Q e i hi he A hp hk W (fun j hj => by by_cases h : j=i · subst j; exact hW ▸ hq.le · rw [show W j=w j from update_of_ne h ..]; exact hw _ hj) δ hd have hx := mail_room hq center center_ends have he' : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Room (mails W F n i) (1*fuel 0 n) := by simp_rw [mails,hW,hF,one_mul]; exact hx obtain ⟨m,h⟩ := h 0 le_rfl hz.le 1 le_rfl F (fun j hj => by by_cases he : j=i · subst j; rw [hF]; exact ⟨center_ends,center_plus,center_even⟩ · rw [show F j=f j from update_of_ne he ..]; exact hf _ hj) he' obtain ⟨k,hV⟩ := runs_order (V i) H A (hp _ hi) let n := max m k have hy l : mails W F l= update (mails w f l) i (bill q l center) := by ext1 j; unfold mails by_cases h : j=i · subst j; rw [hF,hW,update_self] · simp [W,F,h] have ht := h n (le_max_left m k); simp_rw [hW,hy,pay_self,hF] at ht apply projects V i A Q _ _ (fun n l hh => bill_plus (hf l (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hh)).2.1 _ _) q ?_ ?_ δ ht · refine .of_forall (fun k => hV _ (le_max_right ..) _ ?_ _ (center_ends.width _) (center_even.tall _)) simp [fuel0] let C : ℝ := 2⁻¹ ^ n * 2⁻¹^(2*n) have hC : 0.le) (lamp_signs n q 0 1 center center_ends center_plus j zero_lt_one hj i p hp)

proof_context.conclusion: For a point-like axis of a mixed-sign cluster, the walk/sign-transfer induction gives Budget delta for the (E+v)^{-1}-weighted integral.

lemma remote_top (u : ℝ≥0) : ∃ C : ℝ,0≤C ∧ ∀ w : ℝ, 0<w → ∀ E : ℝ,0 ≤ E →
    (Lap 1 (stamp (width w civic-remote u w)) E).re ≤ C*w⁻¹*Real.exp (-((u+u:ℝ≥0):ℝ)*E) := by
  let J := ∫ t,phi t
  have hJ : 0 < J := by
    have hp := integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg (f:=phi) (μ:=volume) (fun t => phi_pos t) phi_int
    apply hp.mpr
    refine IsOpen.measure_pos (μ:=volume) ?_ ⟨0,fun h => one_ne_zero (phi_home.symm.trans h)⟩
    exact isClosed_eq (Complex.continuous_re.comp (hat (stamp circle)).continuous) (continuous_const (y:=0)) |>.isOpen_compl
  refine ⟨J,hJ.le,fun w hw E h => ?_⟩
  let v : ℝ := Real.exp (-((u+u:ℝ≥0):ℝ)*E)
  rw [covered u w E hw h]
  have ht := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left phi w; rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hw)] at ht
  change _ ≤ J*w⁻¹*v
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ t : ℝ,v*phi (w*t) := by
      have he : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => phi (w*t)) := Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero (by
        rw [ht]; exact (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hw) hJ).ne')
      apply integral_mono (leg_int u w E hw h) (he.const_mul v)
      intro t
      unfold leg
      by_cases hz : ((u+u:ℝ≥0):ℝ) ≤ |t|
      · rw [← mul_assoc]; apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (phi_pos _)
        refine (mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.exp_pos _ |>.le) ?_).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
        · linarith [(shade u).nonneg (x:=t)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (neg_le_neg hz) h
      have hi := mt (remote_gap u w hw t) hz
      rw [not_not] at hi; unfold civic remote at hi; rw [cut u w hw, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero] at hi; rw [hi,mul_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _ |>.le) (phi_pos _)
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul,ht]; change v*(w⁻¹*J)=_; ring

proof_context.conclusion: The cut-off response satisfies Re Lap ≤ C w^{-1} e^{-2uE}.

lemma remote_base (u : ℝ≥0) : ∃ c v : ℝ,0<c ∧ 0<v ∧ ∀ w : ℝ,0<w → w≤v → ∀ E : ℝ,0≤E → E≤1 →
    c/(E+w) ≤ (Lap 1 (stamp (width w civic-remote u w)) E).re := by

proof_context.conclusion: The cut-off response satisfies c/(E+w) ≤ Re Lap for small w and 0≤E≤1.
